title: Research: present-head I−G/2 full-row forcing census — 144/144 need +2 (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. Open [#3614](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3614) proved that an 18-entry sample of present-head strict `I − G/2` entries (primary + 5 extras per flag among `{1,9,43}`) need non-private floor +2, and left OQ1: whether the same floor holds for every off-diagonal nonzero Gram source on those three target rows (~48 per row).

This package answers that OQ on the **published** native-channel word: all **144** off-diagonal nonzero Gram entries on `Y7`/`Y23`/`Y59` have every insertion-class zero-mass placement obstructed. Under the inherited class-Z + even nested-transport convention, that is a non-private **lower bound of +2**. No counterexample. The #3614 18-entry sample is a named subset (`in_pr3614_sample`); the remaining 126 sources are new coverage.

Primary feeders unchanged from #3614: `X7:387`, `X58:333`, `X12:131`.

**Scoped obstruction census. No correction words. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/p104-present-head-side-correction-full-row-census/`
- Tip: `b37f6aef686c940a7613db3e04c6234e472399cf`
- Content tip: `42e62a310eb3a4cf80488506ff6baff1d53addd6`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — full-row extension of #3614's census

Closest priors: [#3614](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3614) (18-entry sample + OQ1; leave-alone — `in_pr3614_sample` is a named subset with byte-faithful feeder/class/obstruction match), [#3618](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3618)/[#3610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3610)/[#3601](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3601) (bills leave-alone). Soft-overlap with #3614 is intentional scale-up (verify≈0.87, independent≈0.93, test≈0.97); scientific novelty is the row-complete 144/144 theorem with independent recomputation of all 126 new obstruction tables, not a new obstruction method or a certificate reprint. Bound: published word only; non-private floor only. Does not reopen deferred flag-9 head-step repair. Not a supplier.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-full-row-census/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-full-row-census/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-full-row-census/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-present-head-side-correction-full-row-census/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-present-head-side-correction-full-row-census
```

```text
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_SIDE_CORRECTION_FULL_ROW_CENSUS flags={1,9,43} entries=144/144 need_plus_two primary_feeders=X7:387,X58:333,X12:131 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_SIDE_CORRECTION_FULL_ROW_CENSUS_INDEPENDENT flags={1,9,43} entries=144/144 need_plus_two primary_feeders=X7:387,X58:333,X12:131 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_PRESENT_HEAD_SIDE_CORRECTION_FULL_ROW_CENSUS_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-present-head-side-correction-full-row-census outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.
